businessGoal: Enable visitors to reach out for support or inquiries through a contact form.

scenarios.goal: Verify that the contact form is accessible when navigating to the contact page.
Ensure that all required fields are displayed in the contact form.
Validate that the subject dropdown contains the specified options.
Check that entering a message with fewer than 50 characters shows a validation error.
Verify that a confirmation message is displayed upon successful submission of the contact form.

manual.reason: The story involves direct user interaction with the contact form.

api.reason: The story does not specify any backend validations or data operations that can be tested via an API.

ui.reason: The acceptance criteria describe UI elements and behavior of the contact form.
